source_evidence.known_measurement_defect: The v1 response contract overloaded claim_text as both candidate identity and asserted support, so two exact negative-candidate echoes were misclassified as unsupported claims. Wave 4.2 remains recorded as failed under its preregistered gate.

included: separate exact candidate_assertion and conditional asserted_claim fields
exact directed-trace contracts where relationship semantics matter
excluded: rewriting or replacing the Wave 4.1 or Wave 4.2 historical result
generic route-label accuracy as an activation gate
new cases or changed ground truth
broad most-accurate-engine or statistical superiority claims

plugin.runtime_revision_binding: copied component-bom.json, preregistration, raw traces, projections, summary, outcome-gate report, and run manifest

response_contract.candidate_assertion: always the byte-exact candidate under evaluation
response_contract.asserted_claim: the byte-exact candidate only when supported; otherwise null
response_contract.validation: deterministic candidate identity, disposition, asserted-claim, and required-evidence checks

fresh_dual_index_readiness.evidence: fresh evidence showing both component indexes ready with equal repository, checkout, source, dirty-state, and generation identities

portable_proof_export_smoke.evidence: a newly exported proof packet that passes deterministic verification

falsifier: Do not activate Wave 4.3 if either required precondition or any outcome gate fails. Preserve prior failed runs and stop after this one bounded confirmation rather than tuning against the fixed fixture.
interpretation_limit: This prospective confirmation can support bounded activation of verifiable code intelligence. It cannot rewrite Wave 4.1 or Wave 4.2, establish statistical superiority, or support a broad most-accurate graph or search claim.
